title: This has been a great purchase and has helped my allergies quite a bit
text:
This has been a great purchase and has helped my allergies quite a bit. I live in apartments and the filter changes can be a bit slow/ bare minimum.

I have used this thing for almost 6 months and the filter light has not come on yet. My apartment is 1000 sqft, 2B, 1.5B, and it stays in the master bedroom, usually just on the first setting.

product_metadata.title: Dreamegg Quiet Air Purifiers for Pets Allergy Dander Odor in Bedroom, True HEPA Pet Air Purifiers with Activated Carbon Filter for Pet Smell, Room Air Cleaners Removes 99.97% Pollen Smoke Dust Mold
features: 【Pet Families’ Choice】– Trouble with pet dander or pet odors? Dreamegg TR-8080 is the perfect air purifier for pets. Features the special pet mode, it runs the air purifier at Turbo for 15min and Level III for 5min. This formulated mode is proven good at filtering unwanted odor allergies from pets and smokers, usually quickly by 30% than common purifiers. Bye Bye odors allergies, hi hi fresh air!

【Breanth Easier and Sleep Better】 - Are you sound sensitive or a dark sleeper? Grab this 23dB super quiet air purifier! Sleep mode at night and then forget all about your air purifier while you sleep or you need a quiet environment. Display light can be turned off to enjoy a perfect sleep without any light. For new mom, ambient warm night light and child lock make it wonderful as a baby air purifier.

【Effective 4-in-1 True HEPA Filtration】- Dreamegg allergy HEPA air purifier comes with improved 4 stage hepa air filter and features 360°huge air suction design, purifies a 269ft² room in just 20min, a 500 ft² room in 30 min, effectively bring fresh healthy air around you. While the Nylon Pre-Filter and Activated Carbon Filter efficient captures large particles and absorb odors and fumes, the H13 true hepa filter and sterilization filter traps 99.7% of harmful particles, allergens, and bacteria.

【User Friendly】- You Speak, We Listen. Choose from 4 fan speeds, 2/4/8 timer or sleep mode before heading to bed, and leave the rest to Dreamegg TR-8080. With simple interface & touch buttons, fresh air at home is not a dream. Swedish design and sleek size make it perfect for small or medium-sized rooms, ideal for bedroom, nursery room, basement, dorms, and offices.

【Safety and Thoughtfully】- Complies with California air resources board (CARB) for indoor cleaning devices, FCC ETL certified, this BPA-free air purifier leaves you no worry when considering as a gift. To keep you safe, Dreamegg is 100% ozone-free. Sleek, attractive and budget pick air purifier for your home, bedroom and baby.
